Di codebase G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu, saya perlu memetakan SEMUA tempat di UI/code yang menampilkan fitur khusus "tiket" atau "retail" (bukan F&B).

Cari dan baca:
1. Semua file yang menggunakan `isTiket` atau `business_type === "tiket"` atau `"tiket"` sebagai string
2. Semua file yang menggunakan `isRetail` atau `business_type === "retail"` atau referensi ke retail
3. File navigasi/sidebar dashboard: cari `dashboard-shell.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `nav`, sidebar
4. `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx` — bagaimana POS memilih antara ticket-pos-screen dan pos-screen?
5. File `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` — seberapa besar dan terisolasi?
6. Settings `business-type-form.tsx` — option apa yang ditampilkan?
7. Apakah ada halaman route khusus tiket (mis. `/tickets`, `/members`, `/ticket-transactions`)?
8. Halaman laporan: apakah ada laporan khusus tiket?

Untuk setiap temuan, laporan: file path + baris kunci + SATU kalimat apa yang perlu disembunyikan/diubah.

Buat daftar sederhana: "Untuk menyembunyikan tiket/retail, ubah X di file Y baris Z".

Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. - dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").

content.thinking: Now I have a comprehensive picture of all the tiket/retail references in the codebase. Let me compile the findings into a clear, actionable list.

content.text:
Berikut peta lengkap semua tempat yang perlu diubah untuk menyembunyikan fitur tiket dan/atau retail:

---

## Daftar: "Untuk menyembunyikan tiket/retail, ubah X di file Y baris Z"

---

### GRUP 1 — Onboarding (saat buat bisnis baru)

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\onboarding\onboarding-form.tsx`

- Baris 85-96: Hapus blok `<label>` untuk opsi `value="retail"` — menghilangkan pilihan "Retail / Toko" di form onboarding.
- Baris 98-114: Hapus blok `<label>` untuk opsi `value="tiket"` — menghilangkan pilihan "Tempat Wisata / Tiket" di form onboarding.

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\onboarding\actions.ts`

- Baris 129: Hapus `"retail"` dan `"tiket"` dari array validasi — agar server-side validation ikut menolak nilai tersebut jika masih bisa dikirimi.

---

### GRUP 2 — Settings (pengaturan dalam bisnis)

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\settings\business-type-form.tsx`

- Baris 10: Hapus `{ value: "retail", label: "🛒 Retail" }` dari array `OPTIONS` — menghilangkan pilihan "Retail" di dropdown ubah jenis usaha.
- Baris 11: Hapus `{ value: "tiket", label: "🎟️ Tempat Wisata / Tiket" }` dari array `OPTIONS` — menghilangkan pilihan "Tiket" di dropdown ubah jenis usaha.

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\settings\actions.ts`

- Baris 327: Hapus `"retail"` dan `"tiket"` dari array validasi backend.

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\settings\page.tsx`

- Baris 34, 47, 276-280: Seluruh blok `if (isTiket)` yang fetch `ticket_categories` + `ticket_holidays` dan render `<TicketCategoriesSection>` + `<TicketHolidaysSection>` — hapus untuk menyembunyikan section tiket di Settings.

---

### GRUP 3 — Sidebar / Navigasi Dashboard

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\dashboard-shell.tsx`

- Baris 58: Hapus `"retail"` dan `"tiket"` dari type `BusinessType`.
- Baris 66: Hapus baris `const isTiket = businessType === "tiket"`.
- Baris 79-84: Hapus blok `...(isTiket ? [check-in, ticket-reports, members] : ...)` — ini yang menambahkan menu "Check-in Tiket", "Laporan Tiket", "Anggota" di sidebar.
- Baris 90-92: Hapus kondisi `...(isTiket ? [] : [kas-harian])` — kembalikan "Kas Harian" selalu muncul.
- Baris 93-108: Hapus kondisi `...(isTiket ? [] : [products...])` — kembalikan "Kelola Produk" selalu muncul.
- Baris 112-114: Hapus kondisi `...(isTiket ? [] : [customers])` — kembalikan "Pelanggan" selalu muncul.
- Baris 128-137: Hapus kondisi `...(isTiket ? [] : [laba-rugi, cogs, hpp...])` — kembalikan fitur lanjutan selalu muncul.
- Baris 164: Hapus `|| isTiket` dari kondisi yang menyembunyikan Piutang/Hutang/Supplier/Aset.
- Baris 220-224: Hapus `tiket: "Tempat Wisata / Tiket"` dan `retail: "Retail / Toko"` dari `BUSINESS_TYPE_SUBTITLE` (atau ganti jadi `fnb` saja).

---

### GRUP 4 — POS (kasir)

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\pos\page.tsx`

- Baris 69-139: Hapus seluruh blok `if (business.business_type === "tiket") { ... return <TicketPosScreen /> }` — menghilangkan percabangan ke tiket POS.
- Baris 7: Hapus import `TicketPosScreen`.

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\pos\ticket-pos-screen.tsx` (643 baris)

- File ini eksklusif untuk tiket dan tidak dipakai oleh fnb/retail — bisa dihapus atau dibiarkan sebagai dead code jika blok di `page.tsx` sudah dihapus.

---

### GRUP 5 — Dashboard (halaman ringkasan)

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\page.tsx`

- Baris 72: Hapus ternary `business.business_type === "tiket" ? "ticket_transactions" : "transactions"` — gunakan selalu `"transactions"`.
- Baris 246-252: Hapus blok `{business.business_type === "tiket" ? (<Link href=".../ticket-reports">...)` dan gunakan hanya link Laporan biasa.

---

### GRUP 6 — Route/Halaman Khusus Tiket

Semua rute berikut hanya untuk bisnis tiket. Untuk menyembunyikannya, hapus folder/route-nya atau tambahkan guard `notFound()` jika `business_type !== "tiket"`:

- `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\ticket-reports\` — halaman Laporan Tiket (page.tsx, export, [transactionId]/void).
- `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\members\` — halaman Anggota / Member (page.tsx, [memberId]/...).
- `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\pos\check-in\` — halaman Check-in tiket (page.tsx, check-in-screen.tsx).

---

### GRUP 7 — Offline Queue & Hook (retail-specific)

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\lib\offline-queue.ts`

- Baris 10: `kind: "retail"` — ini tag internal POS retail di antrian offline; jika retail dihilangkan, blok ini bisa disederhanakan.

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\hooks\use-offline-sync.ts`

- Baris 55, 80, 82: Kondisi `sale.kind === "retail"` — membatasi sinkronisasi offline dan print job hanya untuk transaksi retail; tidak perlu diubah jika retail tetap dipakai secara internal, tapi perlu dicatat sebagai referensi.

---

### RINGKASAN PRIORITAS

| Prioritas | Yang harus diubah | File | Baris |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (UI-facing) | Hapus opsi "Retail" & "Tiket" dari onboarding | `onboarding-form.tsx` | 85-114 |
| 1 (UI-facing) | Hapus opsi "Retail" & "Tiket" dari settings | `business-type-form.tsx` | 10-11 |
| 2 (Sidebar) | Hapus semua cabang `isTiket` dari buildNavGroups | `dashboard-shell.tsx` | 66, 79-84, 90-108, 128-164 |
| 2 (Sidebar) | Hapus subtitle "retail"/"tiket" | `dashboard-shell.tsx` | 221-223 |
| 3 (POS) | Hapus percabangan `TicketPosScreen` | `pos/page.tsx` | 69-139 |
| 3 (Dashboard) | Selalu query `transactions` (bukan `ticket_transactions`) | `(dashboard)/page.tsx` | 72 |
| 4 (Routes) | Tambah `notFound()` guard di halaman ticket-reports, members, check-in | 3 halaman di atas | — |
